Managed 20–40 SaaS accounts totaling approximately $3M ARR; portfolio visibility improved from about 40% to 99%, churn reduced to under 30%, and team efficiency improved 30%.

why_company.draft:
AlphaSense is compelling because the role combines three areas where I have the strongest operating evidence: Customer Success domain depth, systems/process design, and executive-level measurement discipline.  The company is scaling an AI-driven market-intelligence platform across thousands of enterprise customers, and this position is specifically responsible for making Customer Success programs measurable, trustworthy, and repeatable.

I have worked both sides of that problem.  I have managed enterprise customer portfolios directly, and I have built the operating layer around them.  At Check Point, I helped move portfolio visibility from roughly 40% to 99%, built workflows across Salesforce, Custify, and Jira, and supported 99% dedicated CSM coverage for accounts above $50K.  At Dedrone, I standardized enterprise onboarding to about one month while engagement increased 25% and renewals increased 20%.

What particularly interests me is AlphaSense's emphasis on NRR, GRR, usage KPIs, QBR ownership, data integrity, systems strategy, and durable escalation.  Those are not independent functions.  They form one operating system for making better Customer Success decisions.

I would bring a field-informed CS Operations perspective: Define the metric contract, make the source of truth defensible, turn strategic programs into repeatable motions, and ensure that executive reporting drives an accountable next action.

cover_letter.draft:
Dear AlphaSense Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Manager, Customer Success Operations role because it brings together the operating responsibilities that have defined the strongest parts of my career: Customer Success strategy, systems and reporting, process design, escalation leadership, and cross-functional execution.

At Check Point, I helped increase portfolio visibility from roughly 40% to 99%, supported 99% dedicated CSM coverage for accounts above $50K, and built operating workflows across Salesforce, Custify, and Jira.  I also managed 20 to 40 SaaS accounts totaling approximately $3M ARR, so my approach to Customer Success Operations is grounded in how data, process, and tooling affect the customer-facing team in practice.

I am particularly aligned with AlphaSense's focus on metrics strategy, QBR ownership, data integrity, and scalable program governance.  I have built health and risk processes, executive reporting, onboarding and adoption motions, escalation workflows, and cross-functional handoffs across Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering.  At Dedrone, I standardized enterprise onboarding to about one month while engagement increased 25% and renewals increased 20%.

I also build AI-assisted workflow systems through Clintware.  I use automation to reduce repetitive operational work, but keep human validation over metrics, external commitments, and executive decisions.  For this role, I built a synthetic candidate operating prototype to model how strategic programs, KPI governance, QBRs, escalation, and scale-readiness can connect without implying knowledge of AlphaSense's private processes.

I would welcome the opportunity to help AlphaSense make Customer Success operations more measurable, durable, and scalable.

Clinton Kosh
